_comment: Lean snapshot for the two Wan 2.2 video machines (xevo-video-fun-control-14b, xevo-video-ti2v-5b). Both workflows use ONLY core ComfyUI nodes (UNETLoader, CLIPLoader, VAELoader, ModelSamplingSD3, KSampler/KSamplerAdvanced, VAEDecode, LoadImage, LoadVideo, GetVideoComponents, Wan22FunControlToVideo, Wan22ImageToVideoLatent, CreateVideo, SaveVideo) — no custom nodes required. Only ComfyUI-Manager is included so comfyui-deploy can restore the snapshot. Hashes are pinned to current public HEAD (git ls-remote); the 'comfyui' core commit is recent enough to include the Wan 2.2 video nodes. Select this file with SNAPSHOT_FILE=snapshot.video.json when running create-machine.mjs.
